notes: Reader-only reliability update over the confirmed working 0.8.6.35 panel. Adds an active-playback watchdog because Pump-ReaderPlayback previously returned immediately while playProc was still alive, so a hung edge-playback or MP3 player could bypass the 0.8.6.34 prefetch watchdog and stop after a phrase such as 'объединившись'. Current playback now has a text-length deadline; on a stall it kills that process, preserves queued future text, and restarts the current block in smaller chunks. The generated MP3 helper is versioned and uses the actual media duration plus a short grace period instead of a 30-minute wait. NUI/panel, strict-trash/economy, combat core 0.7.10.7, Dorna logic and familiar FIX5 are unchanged.
